hook: Some kid scammed my eight year old sister out of her Frost Dragon, and he picked the wrong family.
At three in the morning I joined a dead obby, and there was one other player in the server.
I won admin in my favorite Roblox game for one hour, and I broke the entire economy in about forty seconds.
The kid who scammed my sister came back, and this time he brought his big brother.
My neighbor in Grow a Garden stole every single crop I planted.
On night ninety eight in the forest, one of my teammates stopped being my teammate.
I lost Dress to Impress forty seven times in a row.
Two teamers kept ruining every round of Murder Mystery 2.
In Doors, I made it past door one hundred.
My dad made a Roblox account to prove it was easy.
There's a player in Brookhaven who copies everything I do.
The player who copied everything I did in Brookhaven was sitting in the same room as me.
A level ten noob gave me the only fruit he had.
My grandma beat Tower of Hell on her first try.
The kid who bullied me challenged me to a Roblox race in front of my whole class.
I accidentally sold a pet worth three thousand dollars for one Robux.
My teacher found my Roblox account and turned it into a test question.
A kid stole the best brainrot in my base.
Someone has been leaving notes inside my Bloxburg house, and I'm the only one with the key.
Behind my Bloxburg house there was a second house, and it was built the same day I made my account.
My cousin opened the door to the second Bloxburg house, and now there's only one house left.
A cop in Jailbreak arrested me two hundred and three times in one week, so I spent three days studying him.
Officer Tank chased my car for nine minutes, and he never saw the trap coming.
I found a Piggy map that was an exact copy of my real house.
The Piggy map of my real house got one thing wrong, and that's how my dad figured out who made it.
I got hired as a moderator for a Roblox game with fifty thousand players, and my boss turned out to be nine years old.
A nine year old's mom handed me his Roblox game with fifty thousand players, and he still wasn't done being my boss.
My best friend traded away my whole Adopt Me inventory while I was at dinner, and he thought I'd never find out.
Leo's cousin showed up to the trade with my stolen pet, and Leo had no idea I was the new kid in the bee costume.
A trader stole my neon unicorn, and I made him pay it back with interest.
There's a house in Brookhaven that isn't on the map, and last night I went inside.
The thing in Brookhaven was wearing my friend's avatar, and it knew my real house.
I finally went inside the house that isn't on the Brookhaven map.
Two teamers ruined every round of Murder Mystery 2, so I spent a week building a trap.
The teamer in Murder Mystery 2 thought I was his best friend, and he told me everything.
There was a third teamer in Murder Mystery 2 the whole time, and it was the last person I expected.
My friend went into Doors last night and his avatar still hasn't come out.
I found door one hundred and one in Doors, and it had my friend's name carved into it.
I opened door one hundred and one in Doors so you never have to.
A max level player camped me for six hours straight in Blox Fruits, so I decided to take everything he had.
I waited three months to fight the Blox Fruits player who camped me, and he didn't even remember me.
Six max levels jumped me in Blox Fruits, and the whole server turned on them.
My new neighbor in Brookhaven copies everything I do, and today he copied something I did in real life.
My Brookhaven neighbor copied my real bedroom, so I set a test he couldn't fake.
I found out who my Brookhaven neighbor really was, and he lives closer than I thought.
The deer from 99 Nights in the Forest followed me out of the game, and now it's in all of them.
The deer from 99 Nights got into every Roblox game I joined, so I went back to the forest to end it.
I survived the night the deer from 99 Nights was hunting me, and I'm only alive because of a mistake.
My roommate kicked me out of the Bloxburg house I paid for, so I took the house with me.
I was the last survivor in a round of Piggy, and Piggy stopped chasing me.
A fake cop in Jailbreak arrested me thirty times in one night, so I got him arrested by the whole server.
